<issue>
Enforce OCLA budgets on proxy requests
## Problem
Proxy forwarding accepts OCLA request metadata but does not enforce the declared budget before forwarding the request.

Without admission checks at the proxy boundary, requests can proceed even when their OCLA budget is exhausted or invalid, weakening the budget contract for consumers that rely on proxy-side enforcement.

## Expected outcome
Proxy requests carrying OCLA budget metadata should be admitted only when the budget is valid and sufficient.

The fix should:

- validate OCLA budget admission before proxy forwarding
- reject over-budget or exhausted requests at the proxy boundary
- keep the budget decision close to the existing OCLA wire/proxy path
- include tests covering rejected proxy requests

## Validation
Run the focused proxy/OCLA tests for the changed forwarding path.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the code for proxy forwarding that handles OCLA request metadata/budget (grep -ri ocla, case-insensitive, in non-test source). Report file paths, relevant struct definitions (budget fields), the proxy forward function with its code, and any existing budget validation helpers or error types. Include exact code snippets.

content.content: {"summary": "unstructured reply", "raw": "{\"summary\":\"The proxy forward path carries OCLA request metadata (lineage) but has no OCLA budget fields. Budgets live in separate modules. The proxy only enforces budgets through the org policy gate, which is keyed on gateway tags (person/project), not on OCLA context. I did not find any OCLA budget carried in request metadata.\",\"findings\":[\"Forward function: rust/src/proxy/forward/mod.rs:75 `pub async fn forward_request(State(state): State<ProxyState>, req: Request<Body>, upstream_base: &str, default_path: &str, compress_body: impl FnOnce(serde_json::Value, usize) -> (Vec<u8>, usize, usize), provider_label: &str, extra_stream_types: &[&str]) -> Result<Response, StatusCode>`.\",\"forward_request builds lineage at mod.rs:90-93: `let mut lineage = super::lineage::from_trusted_request(&parts, &body_bytes); if let Some(context) = lineage.as_mut() { context.trace_id.clone_from(&trace_id); }`. The org-policy gate follows at ~mod.rs:97-117: `super::policy_gate::enforce(rules, requested_model.as_deref(), &tags)`. On Err it returns `super::policy_gate::refusal_response(&refusal, provider_label)` with the trace id injected. The lineage is later passed to classify_and_store_proxy_intent (mod.rs:167), schedule_provider_connector (:177), and the request struct at :312.\",\"OCLA request metadata struct, rust/src/core/ocla/types.rs:16: `pub struct OclaRequestContext { pub request_id: String, pub session_id: String, pub agent_id: String, pub content_ref: String, pub tenant_id: Option<String>, #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \\\"String::is_empty\\\")] pub trace_id: String }`. It has no budget fields. It derives Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize.\",\"rust/src/proxy/lineage.rs builds the context from the headers x-leanctx-request-id, x-leanctx-session-id and x-leanctx-agent-id (max 256 bytes each). `from_trusted_headers(headers, body)` returns `Option<OclaRequestContext>` with `content_ref = blake3:<hex of raw body>`, `tenant_id: None` and `trace_id: \\\"tr-unit\\\"` (overwritten in forward_request). `from_trusted_request(parts, body)` only admits the context when the `TrustedGatewayRequest` extension is present. Missing or malformed headers give None (unmanaged, never rejected).\",\"OCLA budget types, rust/src/core/ocla/budget.rs: `pub enum BudgetScope { Org(String), Team(String), User(String) }` (:11); `pub struct BudgetLimit { pub scope: BudgetScope, pub max_tokens_per_day: u64, pub max_usd_per_day: f64 }` (:19); `pub struct BudgetLedger { limits, parents, consumption }` (:33).\",\"BudgetLedger methods: `set_limit`, `set_parent`, `check_budget(&self, scope, tokens: u64) -> OclaResult<()>`, `check_budget_with_cost(&self, scope, tokens, usd: f64) -> OclaResult<()>`, `record_consumption(&mut self, scope, tokens, usd)`, `consumed_tokens`, `consumed_usd`. `check_budget_with_cost` returns `OclaError::InvalidRequest(\\\"budget cost must be finite and non-negative\\\")` for a NaN or negative usd. It returns `InvalidRequest(\\\"invalid USD budget for {current:?}\\\")` for a bad limit, and `InvalidRequest(\\\"budget exceeded for {current:?}\\\")` when `tokens > max_tokens_per_day.saturating_sub(consumed.tokens) || consumed.usd + usd >= max_usd_per_day`.\",\"Error type, rust/src/core/ocla/types.rs:562: `pub enum OclaError { InvalidRequest(String), Unavailable(OclaCapabilityKind), Rejected(OclaCapabilityKind, String), UnsupportedVersion(String) }` (thiserror). `pub type OclaResult<T> = Result<T, OclaError>` is at types.rs:11. There is no dedicated budget error variant.\",\"Proxy-side budget enforcement is rust/src/proxy/policy_gate.rs. `pub enum Refusal { ModelNotAllowed{model}, PersonBudgetExceeded{person,cap_usd,spent_usd}, ProjectBudgetExceeded{project,cap_usd,spent_usd}, PersonRateLimited{person,limit_rpm,retry_after_secs} }` is at :332. `pub fn enforce(rules: &GateRules, requested_model: Option<&str>, tags: &GatewayTags) -> Result<(), Refusal>` is at :371. Also `refusal_response` (:445), `record_spend` (:295), `seed_from_store` (:308), and a private proxy `struct BudgetLedger` (:197) holding person/project spend maps.\",\"Other budget code: rust/src/core/agent_budget.rs has `AgentBudget { agent_id, token_limit: usize, tokens_consumed, reads_count: u32, last_reset }` and `enum BudgetCheckResult { Allowed{remaining}, Exceeded{limit,consumed}, Warning{remaining,percent_used} }`. Its `check_budget(aid, tokens)` is used from rust/src/server/context_gate.rs:68. Also rust/src/core/ocla/wire_api.rs:49-68 has BudgetStore, SetBudgetRequest and BudgetResponse, and rust/src/core/budget_tracker.rs has BudgetTracker. None of these are called from forward_request.\",\"Other proxy files that reference OCLA: proxy/ocla_cache_bridge.rs (response cache adapter"}
